title: Dave Chase — 'An Open Punch List for Incorruptible Organizations'
summary: Dave Chase publishes a 4,000-word follow-up on his Relocalizing Health Substack: a 15-item, five-area build plan derived from Incorruptible, naming the specific firms and lawyers (Wilson Sonsini's David Berger and Amy Simmerman, Alternative Ownership Advisors, Purpose Foundation, Stoel Rives) who can structure the golden share, perpetual purpose trust, and protector role for a mission-locked company.
blockquote: Mission-anchored companies are roughly six times more likely to survive than conventional ones, because their purpose is built into the architecture, where it holds even after the founders, the boards, and the money have all changed hands.
attribution_title: CEO & Co-Founder, Health Rosetta; Board Chair, Nautilus Health Institute; Author, Relocalizing Health
